estatePlan.concept: OFFLINE REFERENCE — Sea Court: the sheltered south arrival follows a curved planted approach into a circular fountain court. A two-storey U frames a north-facing garden, with a sea living wing west and a private primary wing east. A continuous gallery mediates courtyard, entertaining and service rooms; the stair hall and upper landing align. A separate low guest pavilion and shaded pool terrace complete the sequence. This is independently constructed technical evidence, not a Terra result or a proposed change to a saved estate.
